transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer bereavement and support services. My name is Connor. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Connor. I am calling to notify S-Net that my beloved wife, Margaret, passed away three weeks ago after a long illness. The broadband and landline account is currently in her name, and I would like to transfer the services into my own name so the house remains connected.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am very sorry for your loss. Before we access the account profile to begin the bereavement transfer, may I please verify the full billing address and the security question answer on the account?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, of course. It is 14 Meadowbank Gardens, Harrogate, HG1 2BP. And the security question answer is our first family pet, a golden retriever named Rusty.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that verifies the account records. What is the landline telephone number associated with the property?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The landline number is 01423 882914. Margaret managed all our household bills and utilities for over forty-five years, and dealing with all these administrative transfers on my own has felt completely overwhelming and heartbreaking.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am so sorry to hear about Margaret's passing, and I completely understand how overwhelming and emotionally difficult managing all these administrative changes must feel. Please be assured we will make this transition as simple and smooth as possible.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Connor, I really appreciate your kindness.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I have understood correctly, you are notifying us of the sad passing of your wife Margaret, and you wish to transfer the existing broadband and landline package smoothly into your sole name without any interruption to your home connectivity. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly right. I particularly need to ensure our landline number never changes, because all our old friends and doctors have that number.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We will ensure your landline telephone number and broadband package migrate seamlessly with zero downtime or number change.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That takes a great weight off my mind.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under S-Net's Bereavement Policy, we offer three options: full transfer of service to the surviving spouse, continuation of the existing tariff with a name change, or immediate penalty-free cancellation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I definitely want to continue the existing tariff in my name.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: To proceed with the formal name transfer, we require the General Register Office death certificate entry number or the Tell Us Once reference code.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have the Tell Us Once reference number right here from the registrar. It is TUO-882-9104.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am entering that reference code into the government digital verification portal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the system verify it immediately?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The portal has verified the registry record and approved the transfer.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That was much quicker than having to post certified paper copies across the country.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now may I have your full legal name and date of birth for the new primary account holder profile?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, my full name is Arthur James Pendelton, and my date of birth is the fourteenth of August, 1948.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is your preferred contact email address for receiving monthly digital invoices?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My email address is arthur.pendelton48@outlook.com.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have created the new primary account holder profile under your name.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What happens with the outstanding balance from Margaret's final monthly statement?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under our bereavement policy, any accrued charges from the final month are automatically credited to zero as a courtesy waiver.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is extraordinarily compassionate of S-Net. Thank you so much.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your new billing cycle will commence fresh from today at your existing contracted rate of thirty-two pounds per month.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And will the monthly direct debit update to my personal bank account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I will now record your bank account number and sort code for the new Direct Debit instruction.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My bank sort code is 40-23-18, and the account number is 71928402, held at HSBC.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Direct Debit mandate has been lodged electronically and will take effect from the first of next month.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do you need me to re-sign any contract agreement or send any additional documents?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our billing database doesn't care about personal grief; without the legal registrar index code we cannot proceed with account changes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Excuse me! That was a terribly callous and uncalled-for remark to make to someone who has just lost their wife of forty-five years! I provided your code already without complaint!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize for the poor phrasing of my statement. Let us proceed with confirming your service settings.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please remember that people on bereavement calls are going through the worst moments of their lives.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your point is noted, and I sincerely apologize for causing offense.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. Now please confirm what packages are active on our telephone line.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your telephone line includes Unlimited Anytime UK Calls and Call Privacy with Caller Display.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, Margaret added Caller Display so we could screen nuisance callers.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Caller Display remains active at zero additional charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And the broadband speed is Full Fibre 150?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, Full Fibre 150 delivers download speeds of one hundred and fifty megabits per second.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is plenty for my video calls with my grandchildren in New Zealand.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what was the exact date when your late wife passed away?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Connor, as I told you right at the start of this call, Margaret passed away three weeks ago, on the third of October! You already verified the Tell Us Once code which has the exact date!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize, I wanted to double-check the billing prorating cutoff date. I have confirmed October third.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, October third.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also review your telephone directory privacy preferences to update the BT phone book listing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, we were listed under Margaret's name in the Harrogate telephone directory. Should we switch it to Ex-Directory?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Switching to completely Ex-Directory removes your surname and address from both printed books and 118 directory enquiries, preventing unwanted sales calls.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please set the line to completely Ex-Directory. That gives me peace and privacy.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your directory status has been permanently updated to Ex-Directory with zero monthly fee.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, that is another worry removed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check the Priority Services Register to add you as an eligible senior citizen account holder.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What benefits does the Priority Services Register provide?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It guarantees priority line repair within twenty-four hours in case of network outages and provides password-protected engineer visits.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Living on my own now, that priority repair protection would give me great security.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have registered your profile on the Priority Services Register with immediate effect.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, that is very comforting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also establish a nominee password on your account so a trusted family member can speak to us on your behalf if needed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would be very helpful. My daughter Sarah lives twenty minutes away in Ripon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What nominee verbal password would you like Sarah to quote when calling customer services?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let us use the password 'BrimhamRocks', after our favourite walking spot in Yorkshire.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Nominee password 'BrimhamRocks' is now saved for Sarah Pendelton on your account profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will make things so much easier if I ever fall ill and cannot make phone calls myself.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to check, is your broadband and telephone service currently operating without any technical issues today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, both the landline dial tone and WiFi internet are functioning perfectly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will remain the dedicated owner for this bereavement transfer and confirm all records have been updated.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for getting the transfer completed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A full written confirmation pack and updated agreement will arrive in your post within three working days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will keep an eye out for the postman.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your S-Net account or telephone services that I can assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that has sorted everything out. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You may receive a short customer satisfaction survey by SMS after this call; we would appreciate any feedback on our call today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will fill it out. Good day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Please accept our deepest condolences once again, and take care.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, goodbye.
